adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `EmbedController#best` enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` on every request when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` returns nil, then renders `loading` which auto-reloads after 30s (`app/views/embed/loading.html.erb`). Throttling only occurs inside `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` in the job (via a 60s Redis key), so the enqueue path itself is unthrottled and can still create many queued jobs for a popular URL. Also, `retrieved_recently?` sets the Redis key before `perform_retrieve`; if `fetch_http`/`open(url)` fails, there’s no failure state recorded and the page will keep showing the loading loop with repeated enqueues, with no explicit logging/observability in the controller/job code shown.
